MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The waterproof wire splices felt relevant because I have bought electrical connectors before, and they serve a familiar wire-repair purpose.",
    "The quick-setting waterproof epoxy felt like a natural option alongside my tape and vinyl cement purchases because it offers another practical way to bond and repair materials."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Pocket-hole screws, machining inserts and a feeler gauge require specific projects or equipment that my history does not establish I need.",
    "The large heat-shrink tubing and heavy battery-cable terminals relate to electrical repair, but their dimensions and applications do not match a need I currently have.",
    "The large fastener assortment, hundred nylon nuts and steel wool offer possible future usefulness without a clear reason for me to choose them now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of clamps and connectors seemed to be taken as broad interest in hardware, even though each purchase can address a very particular repair.",
    "Interest in one kind of electrical connector seemed to imply interest in other electrical supplies regardless of wire size or connection type."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact fit matters: tubing diameter, cable gauge, fastener size and required equipment determine whether a related item is actually useful to me.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so an older repair purchase does not necessarily mean that project is still active or that I need more supplies for it.",
    "I choose supplies when their purpose fits a concrete need; a large quantity or general usefulness alone does not give me a reason to buy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my interest in practical repairs but stretched it too far into specialized tools and supplies without a clear current use."
}
